notifications.title: Summer has come
notifications.body: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (-7, 8)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 1400 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (-4, 5).

notifications.title: Autumn has come
notifications.body: The harvest is in and the ground is firm: every soldier holds 20% better. The Order marches half as often again; the nomads go home to winter.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (1, 5)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 1750 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the south.
